name: custom-document-link-rules
description: Turn text matched by your own regular expressions into clickable Document Links, for any language.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Rule templates ('filePath', 'lineNum', 'charPos', 'searchText') are not interpolated as JavaScript template literals in untrusted workspaces; only capture groups are substituted.

commands.title: Open File on Line and Char position

custom-document-link-rules.rules.description: Rules that turn matched text into Document Links (regexes)

items.description: If string, first capturing group is used

pattern.description: Find the text pattern containing a linked file (regex)

filePath.description: Construct the linked file path, use any capture group from 'pattern' regex. Use "/" as first character to signal that file path is relative to a fileroot path. Interpolated as a JavaScript template literal (e.g. '${match[1]}', '${workspaceFolder}') after capture groups ($1, ...) are substituted. Not interpolated in untrusted workspaces.

lineNum.description: To which line number do you want to jump, use any capture group from 'pattern' regex and/or '${...}' expressions using the current match position. No default. Interpolated as a JavaScript template literal (e.g. '${match[1]}', '${workspaceFolder}') after capture groups ($1, ...) are substituted. Not interpolated in untrusted workspaces.

searchText.description: Jump to the first occurrence of this text in the target file, use any capture group from 'pattern' regex. No default. Interpolated as a JavaScript template literal (e.g. '${match[1]}', '${workspaceFolder}') after capture groups ($1, ...) are substituted. Not interpolated in untrusted workspaces.

charPos.description: To which character position do you want to jump, use any capture group from 'pattern' regex and/or '${...}' expressions using the current match position. Only used when 'lineNum' is defined. No default. Interpolated as a JavaScript template literal (e.g. '${match[1]}', '${workspaceFolder}') after capture groups ($1, ...) are substituted. Not interpolated in untrusted workspaces.

linkRange.description: Which part of the match becomes the clickable range of the Document Link, as $n ($0 for the whole match). Default: if no 'lineNum' specified uses capture group from 'filePath'.

isAbsolutePath.description: Is the result of 'filePath' an absolute path. default: false

documentLink.description: Create a Document Link for this find. default: true

allowCurrentFile.description: Is a link to the current file allowed. default: false

disableInterpolation.description: Only substitute capture groups ($1, ...) in 'filePath', 'lineNum', 'charPos', and 'searchText'; do not interpolate them as JavaScript template literals. default: false

languageIds.description: Which languageIds this rule applies to. Use null (or omit) to apply to every language.

custom-document-link-rules.fileroot.description: Root directories for the sites in this workspace folder, used to resolve 'filePath' values starting with '/'

custom-document-link-rules.enableLogging.description: Log resolved link targets and opened files to the console. Used for debugging.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
